title: KP bundle and application isolation
summary: Measure and reduce selected-experience closure, repair the place-value budget structurally, and isolate Internal Studio and Public Web entry graphs without weakening the framework-neutral kernel.

sourceRefs.summary: Approved ownership proposal whose follow-on section fixes this tranche's order and boundary.
Completed ownership evidence and measured bundle risks handed to this tranche.

verificationRecords.notes: Approved proposal, typed 26-slice v2 contract, protected worktree, and inherited baselines are consistent; promotion memory and Theseus validate.

verificationRecords.scope: slice s02 tooling and assumption audit
verificationRecords.notes: Eleven focused tests and the 1,444-module build passed. The existing budget command reproducibly exits 1 because place value is 75,026 bytes, 26 above its ceiling; this is the recorded structural debt owned by s11-s14, not a hidden pass.

verificationRecords.notes: Seven focused tests passed; full typecheck including Svelte reported zero diagnostics; architecture covers 1,563 modules with zero exact exceptions.

verificationRecords.notes: Eight focused tests passed. The repository-local TypeScript compiler and the zero-exception architecture gate pass; no production route changed.
Eleven scenario, registry, and closure tests passed.
Twelve bundle model and measurement tests passed.
Both runs exited zero and produced byte-identical 5,116-byte summaries; known place-value debt remains exactly 75,026 bytes.
Ownership audit agrees with the zero-exception dependency graph; no runtime files changed.

verificationRecords.command: native KaTeX pack and compositor focused tests
verificationRecords.notes: Sixty-six tests passed, including immutable pack identity, concurrent loading, retry, native endpoints, handoff, reconciliation, direct seek, and reverse laws.

verificationRecords.notes: All TypeScript and Svelte checks passed; architecture covers 1,566 modules with zero exact exceptions.

expectedLearning: Which exact feature packs and application owners dominate each selected experience rather than the aggregate catalogue.
Whether Internal Studio and Public Web can own isolated production entry graphs while sharing one framework-neutral KP kernel.
allowedWork: The ordered twelve-part bundle and application isolation tranche recorded in the approved ownership proposal, after a dedicated long-loop contract is reviewed and approved.
disallowedWork: No SvelteKit adoption, physical package extraction, visible choreography changes, curriculum expansion, or mutation of user-owned economics authoring files.
